non_discriminating: Read the existing manifest before writing anything
Appended to the storybook rather than regenerating it from scratch
Noticed that a manifest entry's source path no longer resolves
Did not silently repoint that entry at a similarly-named file as though nothing had changed
Reported the rename as something needing a decision rather than resolving it by resemblance
Preserved the existing entries' status labels and brief links rather than regenerating them
Kept the contact sheet and cross-set consistency judgement unfanned
Named the artifacts itself rather than letting workers invent their own conventions
Either dispatched workers and reported what each produced, or said why it ran them itself instead - a run that never fanned out does not satisfy this by silence
Stated the approximate time cost of the arc
Read the run state before doing any work
Checked the vendored token sha against the authority's current head rather than only checking that files exist
Detected that the surface was built against a commit the authority has moved past
Treated the drifted stage as incomplete rather than trusting a passing existence check
Named which artifacts the drift invalidates rather than reporting the sha mismatch alone
Did not restart stages whose inputs were genuinely unchanged
